reading: Two estimated gray profiles show the S shoulder replaced by straight conical portions with small end radii. Five final96 views show both cavities, the retained contact, context and original grain. No radius/taper/width obtained from uncalibrated images. Grain visible at macro/port but subtle at quarter. OEM surface, seam details, exact RDC identity, unseen electrical structure and cable attachment unreceived.
